source_of_truth: ERA33 Phase4 review queue data contract and test artifacts
scope: Define producer-side rules for creating metadata-only ERA33 review queue items. No runtime implementation. No CORE change. No external API.

producer_rules.event_id_policy: Stable deterministic id from chain, address, signal_family, timestamp bucket and source_mode. Must not encode attack classification.
producer_rules.dedupe_policy: Same event_id replaces nothing automatically; producer emits append-only candidate and downstream dedupe may ignore duplicates.
producer_rules.urgency_policy: Urgency is review priority only. It is not risk, probability, confidence or recommendation.
producer_rules.missing_evidence_policy: Every item must list evidence required before ERA32 can make any truth decision.
producer_rules.ttl_policy: Producer must set expires_at according to urgency band defined in Phase4.
producer_rules.source_mode_policy: Producer must label source as CONFIRMED, MEMPOOL_EXPERIMENTAL or OFFCHAIN_SUPPORT.
producer_rules.fail_closed_policy: If required fields are missing or forbidden fields are present, producer must emit no queue item.

test_requirements_next_phase: Validate producer contract references Phase4 target contract.
Validate producer cannot emit forbidden fields.
Validate no CORE, root, wallet, trade, order or API behavior is introduced.
